seo_title: Consumer Health & Brand Distribution | MEVCO International
seo_description: MEVCO International is developing market-entry and distribution partnerships for consumer health brands in Lebanon.
h1_01: Connecting global brands to local markets.
p_01: A Lebanon-based company developing focused importation, distribution, and market-entry solutions for international consumer health and wellness brands.
p_02: A local route-to-market partner for international brands.
p_03: Designed around pharmacies and specialty retail.
p_04: Thoughtful partnerships and lasting commercial value.
p_05: MEVCO International is a Lebanon-based business being developed to represent, import, and distribute selected international consumer brands.
p_06: Our founding team brings experience from several commercial sectors, including healthcare retail. We are establishing MEVCO as a dedicated platform for thoughtful market entry and long-term brand development.
p_07: A selective portfolio vision centered on products that meet real consumer needs.
p_08: Products supporting infants, parents and everyday family care.
p_09: Skin, hygiene and family personal-care essentials.
p_10: Selected products subject to relevant local approvals.
p_11: Potential OTC categories as regulatory capabilities develop.
p_12: We combine market research, disciplined distribution planning and retailer-oriented brand development.
p_13: Evaluate price positioning, local demand, competitive products and regulatory feasibility.
p_14: Develop compliant sourcing, importation, inventory and sales arrangements.
p_15: Develop retailer relationships, merchandising plans and transparent performance reporting.
h2_04: Rooted in Lebanon. Built with a wider vision.
p_16: Our initial focus is creating a credible commercial platform in Lebanon. Future expansion will be guided by partner needs, market fit and demonstrated execution.
p_17: Tell us about your product portfolio and objectives for Lebanon. We welcome conversations about potential distribution partnerships.
